web.title: List of Tour de France general classification winners
web.description:
## History
When Alcyon cyclist [Maurice De Waele](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maurice_De_Waele) won the Tour in [1929](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1929_Tour_de_France) while ill, the organisers decided to introduce national teams the following year, to stop team tactics from undermining the race.

# Tadej POGACAR
## **Tadej Pogačar: From the football pitch to the road**
Born in September 1998, just outside Komenda, north of Ljubljana, Pogacar's drive for success started at a young age.
